title: JC H2 Physics — Ideal Gas Law
subject: science
disclaimer: Assumes 1 mol of an ideal gas, equilibrium and Kelvin temperature. Real gases deviate at high pressure/low temperature.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict the pressure change when volume halves at fixed temperature and amount of gas.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Change Kelvin temperature and gas volume; pressure responds according to the ideal gas law.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: With a fixed number of moles, P = nRT/V; temperatures must be measured in kelvins.

check.question: At fixed Kelvin temperature, halving volume does what to ideal gas pressure?
check.explanation: Boyle's law is the fixed-temperature case of PV = nRT.
